title: Cyber cat rooftop chase

language_ideas.en: A cyber cat chases a glowing drone across a rainy Shanghai rooftop at night.
language_ideas.zh: 一只赛博猫在雨夜上海屋顶追逐发光无人机。

shot.title: Rooftop chase
shot.description: A cybernetic cat sprints across a wet high-rise rooftop while a glowing quadcopter drone escapes ahead through visible rain, with a recognizable Shanghai landmark skyline behind them, including Oriental Pearl Tower or Lujiazui tower silhouettes.
shot.camera: low side-tracking camera following the cat and drone in the same direction
shot.motion: the glowing drone leads the chase path and escapes forward; the cyber cat follows the drone's direction of travel
shot.music: tense electronic pulse with rain ambience

identity_constraints: cyber cat is one indivisible required subject: a normal cat does not satisfy this target
the cat must show visible cybernetic traits such as metallic limbs, mechanical body panels, glowing collar, LED seams, or robotic silhouette
do not split cyber and cat into separate concepts; the cybernetic traits must be attached to the cat
visual_attributes: metallic or mechanical cat body details
glowing collar or LED seams on the cat
spatial_relationships: cat and drone appear in the same shot
the glowing drone leads the chase path
the cyber cat follows the drone's direction of travel
rooftop edge and Shanghai landmark skyline anchor the location
motion_contracts: the cyber cat is visibly chasing, not posing
the glowing drone is visibly escaping forward, not hovering still
the drone must not trail after the cat
the cat must not lead the drone
rain and reflections reinforce forward motion
negative_constraints: no ordinary cat without cybernetic details
no generic animal without cybernetic details
no drone trailing after the cat
no hovering static drone as the main action
no generic city skyline without Shanghai landmark cues
success_criteria: cyber cat appears in at least half of sampled frames with visible mechanical, metallic, glowing, or robotic details
ordinary cat alone must be scored as missing cyber cat
glowing drone appears in at least half of sampled frames
the drone leads the chase path while the cyber cat follows the drone's direction of travel
rain or wet reflections appear in most sampled frames
Shanghai location is supported by recognizable Oriental Pearl Tower, Shanghai Tower, or Lujiazui skyline cues
cat-drone chase relationship is readable and not reversed
